top_concerns.note: EIC top 5 concerns (summary.json) mixed blind with the panel's main issues; one Sonnet annotator per paper (evals/gap_match_prompt.md) matched each human main issue. recall = share of human issues matched; precision = share of AI items matching >=1 human issue.

importance_note: Human main issues with status minor_only (raised by the AI only as a minor point) count as not hit, as in the overlap hit rate; there is 1 such issue, so n = 1018. Consensus here means 2+ humans raised the issue as a main point (219); the misses table counts any human mention, including minor points (221).
